main_text.l: portas; vndique angustiæ. Quo in discrimine suo, cùm
Innocentij Papæ auxilio diuino (vt ait Platina) Iohannes vti vellet,
parum in eo expertus est mentis diuinæ. Senfit enim clau-
sum sibi diuinum eius auxilium omne, nisi grandi precio, vtri-
usque scilicet regni, pacisci cum eo vellet. Credo autem, si se
conuertisset ad Deum, vel si Innocentius Deo plenus, minoris
multò cum eo tràfigere potuisse. Illetum, nisi se regno
Iohannes exuat, nihil audit: atque ita vt se exueret, planè per vim
perpulit. O virum sanctum! ô speculum innocentiæ! Nam
quòd tu voluisse refers Iohannem, haud alia in eo facto fuit voluntas
eius, quàm qualem dixisti Gregorij fuisse erga Impera-
torem, vellet nollet, cùm domi turbatæ res, cùm foris, hostis
imminaret. Sed quid tum si voluit Rex? Regnum ipsum
noluit, vniuersitas regni, quæ in causa hac contradicere potuit, per
os Archiepiscopi contradixit, eaque contradictio eius de iure
fuit admittenda. Noli ergo nimis blandiri tibi de re nihili:
multis enim modis nulla fuit, ea tum subiectio. Concessa pr-
imùm non sine periurio, nam contra solenne iuramentum Deo à
Rege præstitum, ante impositam illi de more coronam. Secun-
dò, Reseruatain eo Iustitia, Libertates, Regalia, per verba, [Saluis
nobis, & haredibus nostris, Iustitijs, Libertatibus & Regalibus nostris]
atq; ita concessio de iure nulla. Tertiò, Reclamatum ei est à
Regno, Semper clàm & palam reclamante, cum profundis suspiriis
Stephano Archiepiscopo Cantuariensi. Quartò, Relaxatum pòst,
quicquid in eo pactum: sic habet Eulogij Author. An. 1214.

page.notes: The page's left margin holds two notes, "a Matt. Par. Histo. min. in ann 1213." and "b Supplicat. animar. in porg.", both placed at their reference marks. The reference mark "b" stands before "Thomas Morus" with the note beside the "Apud Tortum" line; the mark is printed as a superscript and may be read as part of the text, so it is left as "b Thomas Morus" with the note tied to it. The reference "a" before "Semper" is similarly printed as a superscript. Several italic and roman boundaries, and the Latin spelling "idab eò", "quodd", "Quodfi" (read as Quodsi), "Reseruatain", "tràfigere", "Illetum", and "vniuersitas", are copied from a low-resolution scan and may be misread. A small stray mark appears in the left margin near the line "Illetum"; it is not text and is not transcribed. The paragraph division is uncertain: the text runs as one paragraph from the page top to its last line, as no clear indent was visible. The name "Stephano" and the phrase "Iohannes vti vellet" are read with reasonable confidence but should be checked.
